The Quasar Engine will be its own machine with its own black hole, seeded once from a Kerr T2 (a §9Quasar Seed§r made on the Compressor Module with a hole of at least 256 SM). It runs no recipes.
- Feed it gas to build an §9accretion disc§r. Hold its Eddington balance §9E§r in the zones you know from the Eye, and let its flux charge and §9erupt§r.
- The disc spins and grows the hole and drives §9two jets§r. Each jet goes to the Eye (stabilisation, from T7) or to a Burst Thermaliser Crown (power).
- A linked quasar holding your Eye steady will be the heart of the T6 → T7 milestone: the §9Stability Link§r, 30 minutes unbroken.

[note]§lComing later.§r This part of Beyond the Stars is designed but not built yet, so the quest is a checkbox: tick it to keep the chapter moving. The numbers above are the current plan and may change. When it ships, this quest gets its real tasks under the same id, and a ticked box is cleared so the real step counts.[/note]
